edit.description: the Flow line, last in the printed order
the filing times the two age figures read
the verdict history the ship and failed-merge counts read
the three figures and the no-history case

summary: status prints a Flow line — median filing-to-ship, the longest a ready work entry is waiting now, failed merges per shipped entry — computed from git and the verdicts at the moment of asking
acceptance: flume status prints the three flow figures, each derived at the moment of asking from the verdict history and the filing times, and stores none of them
tests: flume status prints the median time from filing to shipping over the verdict history
flume status prints the longest a ready work entry has been waiting
flume status prints failed merges per shipped entry
flume status prints the flow line with no figures when the verdict history is empty
notes: The Goals line beside it is not here: a goal's rank is a package field the engine may not read, which is an open question in the questions directory. Flow is engine facts throughout — filing times, verdicts, the pickable set.
